name: What should I prepare before meeting with a laundry room remodeling contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before meeting with a laundry room remodeling contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your initial consultation, measure your existing washer and dryer or note the dimensions of new appliances you plan to purchase, including door-swing clearances. Identify whether you need an electric or gas dryer hookup, and decide if a utility sink, built-in ironing board, or drying racks are essential for your routine. Sharing these functional needs and appliance dimensions early helps us plan accurate plumbing cut-ins, electrical outlet locations, and custom cabinet layouts during the initial estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather your appliance dimensions, identify your dryer connection type (gas or electric), and list priority features like sinks or custom storage.
